Marissa — quick read through and initial take. The two latency spikes on 2027-02-07 line up with an autoscaling hiccup when a large batch of non-streaming traffic from an A/B test hit a small pool of Dedicated hosts. I pulled the kernel traces and KV-cache pressure logs; attaching the filtered log.

Attachment: latency_spike_log_20270207.csv (CSV, 180KB)

Prelim actions:
- Root cause: suboptimal pooling policy + sudden batch expansion (we had a config hole for certain legacy customer routes).
- Short-term: revert pooling policy for affected pool (done 2027-02-08 03:30 UTC) — reduced 95p latency by ~630ms for that cohort.
- Medium: rollout a config validation check in the deployment pipeline to catch incompatible pooling configs (owner: infra-deploy; ETA: 2 weeks).
- Long: add a predictive scaling probe tied to request mix (research spike ongoing; ETA: Q2).

Slide bullet (for Logan): "Latencies: two mid-month spikes due to pooling config; mitigated with pool revert (95p ↓630ms). Validation gate to prevent recurrence; deployment ETA 2w."

I'll follow up if the postmortem adds anything else.

—Vivek

Thanks — I dug into the uptime blip that shows up on the dashboard (2027-02-07 02:55–03:05 UTC). Summary: a transient metadata service stall during maintenance windows caused a brief cascade of reconnects that looked like 5xxs to customers on a specific region. Impact: ~0.3% of Hosted API requests in that window, two Dedicated tenants reported elevated errors and one opened a support ticket (Orion Analytics).

Postmortem status: draft complete, will share the doc link once I get a review from SRE. Short term mitigation: shift maintenance windows to stepped rollouts and add a read-only fallback for metadata reads (owner: SRE; ETA: 1 week). Longer term: improve circuit-breaker visibility per region (owner: reliability; ETA: Q3).

Attachment: uptime_digest_Q1-2027.xlsx (XLSX, 420KB)

Slide bullet for Logan: "Uptime: isolated metadata service stall impacted minor % of traffic; doc complete and mitigation (stepped rollouts + read-only fallback) prioritized — customer outreach coordinated with CS."

Evelyn
